title: Nationwide Access, Referrals and Emergency Care Abroad on the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
1. Every plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans may be held nationwide, wherever the retiree lives in the United States.
2. On a plan scheduled for nationwide access, the retiree may see any provider who accepts Medicare at the in-network cost share.
3. A referral for an in-network specialist visit is required on a plan only where the schedule below says so.
4. The plan's payment for emergency care outside the United States is limited, for the plan year, to the figure scheduled for that plan in USD.

| Group plan | Where the plan may be held | Any Medicare provider at in-network cost share | Referral needed for an in-network specialist | Annual limit on emergency care abroad |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | Nationwide | Yes | No | 50000.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | Nationwide | Yes | No | 75000.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | Nationwide | Yes | No | 100000.00 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | Nationwide | No | No | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | Nationwide | No | No | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | Nationwide | No | No | 0 |

## Reading of the schedule

No plan of the book requires a referral for an in-network specialist visit, and no plan of the book is held on any narrower basis than nationwide.

The limit on emergency care abroad is a limit on what the plan pays in the plan year, not on what the retiree may spend. It rises through Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO), Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO), and stands at 0 on the three plans whose names carry EGWP.
